clue.text: Getting on train for college

parts.note: getting on a bus or train is boarding it
to train someone is to school them

explanation.surface: A commuter hops on a train to get to college.
explanation.definitionFit: A residential school where pupils live in term time is a kind of college in the broad sense of an educational establishment.

clue.text: Supports people have when annoyed

definitions.meaning: props up or endorses, as a verb
an angry person is said to have their hackles raised, their spine bristling like a cat's

explanation.surface: A remark on how people prop each other up when tempers fray.
explanation.definitionFit: To support someone is to stand behind them; an irritated person is described with the idiom of a bristling spine.

clue.text: Advent is a very long time to go 80

definitions.meaning: the church season before Christmas, which spans four Sundays, roughly a month of them

definitions.text: a very long time to go
definitions.meaning: an idiom for an age, an interminable stretch

explanation.surface: A child complains that the wait through Advent for Christmas seems endless.
explanation.definitionFit: Advent covers four Sundays, about a month's worth; the idiom means an interminably long period.

clue.text: As a container it can't be beaten

definitions.text: As a container it can't be beaten

parts.words: As a container it can't be beaten
parts.note: the barrel-shaped vessel for oil shares its name with the percussion instrument, which is beaten; in its storage sense nobody strikes it

explanation.surface: Praise for a vessel that is unbeatable as a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A metal cylinder for oil or chemicals shares its name with the instrument that is struck with sticks.

clue.text: Thought it will turn up in time

indicators.note: the reversed pair sits inside the word for the time of day

parts.note: noon is a time, midday

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the word it from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Someone trusts an idea will occur to them in due course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will turn up' makes TI, which goes 'in' NOON to give NO-TI-ON.
explanation.definitionFit: A notion is an idea or belief, a synonym of a thought.

clue.text: Helps those who have been had, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the word for dupes is spoken, giving a different spelling

parts.note: people who have been conned are suckers

explanation.surface: A charity aids victims of fraud.
explanation.definitionFit: To succour is to give aid in distress, so the verb form means assists.

clue.text: He crashed awkwardly at the end of the race-bad luck!

indicators.note: the letters of he crashed are rearranged clumsily
takes the final letter of race

explanation.surface: A rider falls at the finish line, and onlookers commiserate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awkwardly' turns HECRASHED into HARDCHEES; 'at the end of' race adds E.
explanation.definitionFit: HARD CHEESE is British slang, often ironic, for tough luck or a misfortune.

clue.text: Feeling extremely happy having reached the N Pole?

definitions.meaning: the North Pole sits at the very top of the globe, so the explorer is literally perched up there

explanation.surface: An Arctic explorer's joy on arriving at the North Pole.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for elation also describes, literally, standing at the planet's topmost point.

clue.text: Responsible for a convict getting privileges

definitions.meaning: a prisoner given special freedoms for good behaviour

explanation.surface: Who is in charge of a prisoner granted perks?
explanation.definitionFit: A reliable person can be relied on; a prisoner granted extra liberties as reward is given the same name.

clue.text: One may peg out playing it out of doors

definitions.text: One may peg out playing it out of doors

parts.words: One may peg out playing it out of doors
parts.note: to peg out usually means to die, but in this lawn game it means finishing by striking the ball against the central peg

explanation.surface: A grim-sounding remark that someone might die playing outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: In this mallet-and-hoops lawn game, a player finishes by hitting the peg, called pegging out.

clue.text: He looks after a dog on a hill

parts.note: a cur is a mongrel dog
a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor

explanation.surface: Someone minds a dog that lives on a hillside.
explanation.definitionFit: A museum or gallery keeper takes care of the collection, so is one who looks after things.

clue.text: Place, it is within the borders of Singapore

indicators.note: the pronoun is placed inside the other letters
takes the first and last letters of Singapore

explanation.surface: A traveller's note that some location lies inside Singapore's frontiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the borders of' gives S and E; 'within' sets IT between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A site is a location, a spot where something is.

clue.text: All-star casts?

parts.note: not theatre line-ups full of celebrities but predictions cast from the positions of the stars

explanation.surface: A film poster boasting a celebrity ensemble.
explanation.definitionFit: Astrological forecasts are drawn up, or cast, entirely from the stars and planets.

clue.text: Almost the end of a union dispute?

definitions.text: Almost the end of a union dispute?

parts.words: Almost the end of a union dispute?
parts.note: the union is a marriage, not a trade union; the provisional court order comes just before the divorce is final

explanation.surface: A strike seems close to being settled.
explanation.definitionFit: In English law this is the provisional divorce order, made absolute later, so the marriage is nearly over.

clue.text: More unfortunate choice in the marriage ceremony

definitions.meaning: the vows promise 'for richer, for' the other option

explanation.surface: A wedding where a regrettable decision is made.
explanation.definitionFit: Less wealthy means worse off; the traditional vows pair it against richer.

clue.text: Insect immature at first then finally with it

parts.note: green means inexperienced or unripe
fly is slang for knowing or sharp

explanation.surface: A creature that starts out young and ends up trendy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at first then finally' only orders the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a sap-sucking aphid, a garden pest and a small bug.

clue.text: A banker's order in mid-America

indicators.note: the letters of a banker's are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A bank instruction issued in the middle of the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: This Great Plains state lies in the centre of the USA.

clue.text: I'm set back with a succession of wretched experiences

indicators.note: the two letters of I'm are reversed

parts.note: a series is a succession of things

explanation.surface: Someone reflects on a string of setbacks.
explanation.definitionFit: Miseries are sufferings, unhappy episodes.

clue.text: Share jobs equally when there's dirt at home

parts.note: muck is filth
in means at home, not out

explanation.surface: Housemates divide chores fairly when the place is filthy.
explanation.definitionFit: The British idiom means to pitch in and take part fairly in shared work.

clue.text: There's a change in the Old Testament

indicators.note: the letters of there's are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone notes an alteration in a biblical text.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a book of the Hebrew scriptures, named for the queen who saved her people.

clue.text: Favour shown to the electorate

parts.note: favour here is a ribbon badge, as worn by election candidates and their supporters, not a kindness to voters

explanation.surface: A politician doing favours for voters.
explanation.definitionFit: A rosette-shaped ribbon in party colours is worn at elections as a badge, an old sense of favour.

clue.text: More work here-or less, many hope!

definitions.text: More work here-or less, many hope!

parts.words: More work here-or less, many hope!
parts.note: Thomas More wrote of an ideal commonwealth; many dream of a perfect place with less toil

explanation.surface: A wry line about a workplace where people want less labour.
explanation.definitionFit: Thomas More's book names an imagined perfect society, now any ideal place.

clue.text: Devote to re-writing scene or act

indicators.note: rewriting the words scene or act rearranges their letters

explanation.surface: A playwright gives their time to revising a scene or act.
explanation.definitionFit: To consecrate is to dedicate solemnly to a purpose.

clue.text: Boring makers of laws

parts.note: not tedious legislators but tools that bore holes, whose name is the word laws rearranged

explanation.surface: A dig at dull politicians.
explanation.definitionFit: These pointed tools make holes in leather or wood, so they are boring devices.

clue.text: I follow through with spirit

indicators.note: I comes after the word for through

parts.note: per means by way of, through

explanation.surface: Someone pursues something with enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a fairy or sprite in Persian myth.

clue.text: Characters that are inclined to be distinctive

definitions.text: Characters that are inclined to be distinctive

parts.words: Characters that are inclined to be distinctive
parts.note: not people with eccentric leanings but printed letters that slope, used for emphasis

explanation.surface: Eccentric people who like to stand out.
explanation.definitionFit: Sloping type is used to make words stand out on the page.

clue.text: Promenade concert performer

parts.note: not a musician at the London Proms but a white-faced clown from seaside pier shows, the promenade being the pier

explanation.surface: A musician at the Proms classical series.
explanation.definitionFit: The French pantomime clown was a staple of British seaside pier entertainment.

clue.text: A healthy comparison

parts.note: a simile used to describe someone in excellent health

explanation.surface: A doctor likens a patient's condition to something robust.
explanation.definitionFit: The stock simile likens a person in robust health to a musical instrument in good trim.
